findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent, get_latest_signals, list_facets, get_related_signals · Public sink: register_agent, get_latest_signals, scope_signals · Destructive: get_latest_signals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent · Private data: register_agent, get_latest_signals, list_facets, get_related_signals · Public sink: register_agent, get_latest_signals, scope_signals · Destructive: get_latest_signals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
